name: matheases
description: A test familiar-names pack of the #233 acceptance suite (criterion 13): two rate-function words, each mapped to an ease@1 entry with its parameters. smooth maps to sigmoid(10), an entry every build holds; wobble names wobble_in_out, an entry no build holds, which the pack check must refuse, naming the word.

smooth.conversion: the upstream smooth(t, inflection = 10) is our sigmoid(10) over the key's segment

wobble.conversion: none: no ease@1 entry is named wobble_in_out
